classification.difficultyReason: Construct the supplied paired-data scatter plot and combine scoring and defensive criteria to judge performance, weighing F’s highest goals scored against small defensive differences. Interpretation links two familiar quantities; no advanced technique is required.

inlines.text: The table below gives the number of ‘goals for’ (scored by the team) and the number of ‘goals against’ (scored by the opposing team) for each team in a soccer competition.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Represent this information on a scatter plot. Use the $x$-axis to represent ‘goals for’ and the $y$-axis to represent ‘goals against’.

answer.worked: Plot each team as an ordered pair (goals for, goals against). Use evenly spaced scales on labelled axes. The plotted points are A $(36,31)$, B $(45,16)$, C $(22,33)$, D $(26,26)$, E $(20,64)$, F $(59,16)$, G $(24,53)$, H $(41,42)$, I $(23,47)$, J $(43,21)$, K $(32,49)$ and L $(41,14)$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6 table and part a; teacher page 85 question 6a
spec.description: Complete scatter plot of the twelve team pairs, with horizontal grid lines and team labels.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Use your scatter plot to answer the following questions.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Which team is the best team in the competition? Why?

answer.short: F: it scored the most goals (59) and conceded very few (16).
answer.worked: F is furthest to the right on the scatter plot and near the bottom. It scored 59 goals, the greatest number, and conceded 16, only two more than the lowest number conceded.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: Which team is the worst team in the competition? Why?

answer.short: E: it scored the fewest goals (20) and conceded the most (64).
answer.worked: E lies at the top-left of the scatter plot. Its 20 goals for is the lowest total, while its 64 goals against is the highest total.

children.label: iii
children.prompt: Which of team J and team H is better? Why?

answer.short: J: it scored slightly more goals than H (43 compared with 41) and conceded far fewer (21 compared with 42).
answer.worked: J lies slightly to the right of H and much lower. J scored 43 goals and conceded 21; H scored 41 and conceded 42. Both comparisons favour J.
